Name: Nahash, King of Ammon
Summary: Nahash, king of Ammon, besieged Jabesh-gilead and demanded every man's right eye as terms of surrender. Saul's rescue of the city launched his kingship. Nahash later died, and David showed kindness to his son Hanun for Nahash's earlier kindness to him.
KeyStory: Nahash's cruel terms at Jabesh-gilead gave Saul his first victory — and David later repaid an old kindness to his son.
KeyVerses: 1 Samuel 11:1; 1 Samuel 11:2; 1 Samuel 12:12; 2 Samuel 10:1; 2 Samuel 10:2; 1 Chronicles 19:1
RelatedPeople: King Saul; King David; Hanun, Son of Nahash
LifeLesson: Cruelty invites judgment, but an old kindness is still remembered and repaid.
